chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Kills the Yaksha King Before a Semi-Ancestor
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen hunts down and kills the Yaksha King, only for a semi-ancestor to revive him. In an act of ultimate defiance, Xiao Chen strikes again before escaping to the death world.
og_title: Xiao Chen Slays the Yaksha King Twice – A Semi-Ancestor Defied
og_description: A breathtaking pursuit ends with Xiao Chen killing the Yaksha King twice, once after a semi-ancestor’s revival. Tianwaitian intervenes, and Xiao Chen escapes using the death world recall.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Defies a Semi-Ancestor – Kills Yaksha King Twice
twitter_description: In a daring move, Xiao Chen kills the Yaksha King again after a semi-ancestor revives him, then escapes to the death world, making a powerful enemy.
